title: laguncularia racemosa var. glabriflora
intro: Laguncularia racemosa var. glabriflora, commonly known as Smooth Buttonwood, is a plant species belonging to the family Combretaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Laguncularia racemosa var. glabriflora include wound healing, fever reduction, and the treatment of respiratory issues, attributed to its bioactive constituents which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids.
